plugin.streamer.audio_hint: 8-channel source. Each track = 1 channel (mono) or 2 (stereo). UDP/SRT carry all tracks; WebRTC the 1st (Opus).
plugin.streamer.del_link_confirm: Delete this link? It will stop working.
plugin.streamer.hot_help_off: Auto adaptation: Format is the output; the input is detected then resized/resampled if needed. Re-wiring the source redeploys the encoder (brief cut).
plugin.streamer.hot_help_on: Seamless switch: Format = the source's fixed resolution (no scaling). Re-wiring a source of the same resolution does not cut the stream.
plugin.streamer.preview_no_gw: WebRTC {path}: configure the gateway in Settings → WebRTC to enable the preview.
plugin.streamer.share_hint: Branded page to send to a client to view this stream. Random-token link, revocable.
plugin.streamer.src_auto: Auto adaptation (detect and adapt the input)
type.streamer.cfg.log_level.help: Container log verbosity. Default “Events”: notable facts (start/stop, format change, reconnection, fallback to a degraded path, an input appearing or disappearing) are ALWAYS written — after a failure the log must let you reconstruct the story, and raising the level afterwards recovers nothing. Periodic metrics (fps, counters) are NOT logged: they are already published on :8080. “Verbose” = a flamethrower, one line per frame, to be enabled only for the duration of a diagnosis (the Docker log is not rotated).
type.streamer.cfg.log_level.label: Log level
type.streamer.cfg.slice_mode.help: Follows a sliced source at the head grain (band by band) to process the frame earlier (sub-frame latency). Non-sliced source or mode disabled (default) = historical behaviour.
type.streamer.cfg.slice_mode.label: Slice mode (sub-frame latency)
type.streamer.cfg.video.encoder.help: Hardware encoding offloads about one core per 1080p50 stream (measured) and requires an NVIDIA GPU on the node. “Required” refuses to start without a usable card rather than silently falling back to software; “if available” tolerates the fallback and announces it in the container state.
type.streamer.cfg.video.encoder.label: Video encoder
type.streamer.cfg.video.nvenc_preset.hel: Trades latency for quality, from p1 (fastest) to p7. No effect with software encoding.
type.streamer.cfg.video.nvenc_tune.help: The NVENC equivalent of x264's “zerolatency”. No effect with software encoding.
type.streamer.cfg.video.nvenc_tune.label: NVENC latency profile
type.streamer.label: Streamer
